subtitle: Dikmen Residential Urban Design Project
script: A Sustainable, Walkable and Community-Oriented Neighbourhood
summary: A green, connected and livable residential neighbourhood.

texts.heading: Project Vision
texts.body: A green, connected and livable residential neighbourhood with a high-quality living environment, pedestrian networks, accessible public spaces, and a balanced relationship between built and open areas.

features.title: Walkability
features.text: A safe and continuous pedestrian network.

features.title: Community Living
features.text: Neighbourhood open spaces and daily amenities close to home.

features.title: Sustainability
features.text: Green spaces and shaded routes for a comfortable environment.

features.title: Connectivity
features.text: A clear network of roads and easy access to the city.

features.title: Livability
features.text: A balanced mix of housing, services, and recreation.
